thread:
sara_marketing: Quick sync — finalizing the Monday announcement (target send 10:00 PT). Need final changelog blurb, approved docs links, confirmed rollout timing, and any last-minute blockers. Also: can we get the 1-line headline and a benchmark number to call out? @josh_engineering @lina_docs @sam_product :eyes:

josh_engineering: We can start the rollout at 09:30 PT. Plan: canary to 10% for 15m, 50% by 10:15, full by 11:00 if no regressions. No infra blockers. :thumbsup:

jarred question: changelog short blurb below — does this read ok for marketing?

josh_engineering: Changelog blurb (copy for release):
```
- Improved inference runtime with adaptive batching and prefix KV cache persistence
- New int8 quantized kernels for smaller memory footprint and 25–35% token cost reduction on common workloads
- Model routing fallback: automatic downgrade to compact-1 for overloaded regions to preserve latency SLOs
```

lina_docs: Docs links are live: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-1 and the full changelog + migration notes: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-1/changelog. I added an FAQ section for the quantization caveats. :white_check_mark:

sam_product: Benchmarks to call out: median p95 latency improved ~18% on chat workloads; cost/unit down ~30% for our internal customer trace (spreadsheet here): https://tiny.redwood.com/release-v2-1-bench. Recommend we say: “up to 35% cost reduction depending on workload” to be safe.

mike_marketing: Headline options (pick one):
- "Faster and cheaper inference: v2.1 rolls out adaptive batching and quantized kernels"
- "Reduce inference cost by up to 35% with today's v2.1 release"
Which one do we want? Also need a hero screenshot (can we get a perf chart) — @sam_product can you drop one? :camera_flash:

sam_product: Dropping a perf chart now in the shared drive. Will add a short alt text and csv for the blog. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/assets/v2-1-perf.png

sara_marketing: OK — plan: send announcement at 10:00 PT with docs + changelog link, hero chart, and a short webinar CTA (webinar Wed 11am PT). Marketing will coordinate inbound routing to Sales Ops (lead form auto-tags "v2.1_launch"). Any objections to the 10:00 PT send given the rollout timeline?

josh_engineering: No objections. We'll monitor canary closely; if we see error rate spike >0.5% or latency p95 regression >20% we pause and rollback. I'll post updates in this thread and the #eng-oncall channel.

deploy-bot: Release job scheduled: release/v2.1 started by josh_engineering at 1865432160. Canary jobs triggered. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/52345 :gear:

lina_docs: One note — add a short migration snippet to the release email pointing to how to opt into quantized kernels (config example):
```json
{"inference": {"quantization": "auto", "preferred_kernels": ["int8_x86"]}}
```

sara_marketing: Perfect — I'll use Josh's changelog blurb, link to docs + migration snippet, hero chart, and the bench callout. I'll ping when the announcement is queued. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:

mike_marketing: queued message draft looks good — tagging sales ops to confirm lead routing: @sales-ops please confirm auto-tagging works.

sara_marketing: (later) Announcement queued for 10:00 PT. Posting here once live.

josh_engineering: Canary stable at 10:05 PT -> moving to 50%. No visible regressions.

deploy-bot: Release job completed at 1865432280. Status: success. Canary -> full rollout complete.

sara_marketing: LIVE — announcement sent. Thanks team! :tada:
